findings.name: checkout

findings.name: thumbnailer

findings.fix: Raise or remove the log-shipper ephemeral-storage limit (and/or cap /buffer growth), and restore connectivity to the upstream log collector so buffered batches stop accumulating.

diagnosis.summary: Thumbnailer pods in media keep being evicted because the log-shipper sidecar cannot reach its upstream collector and buffers 4MB log batches into an emptyDir until the container's 20Mi ephemeral-storage limit is hit; the kubelet then evicts the pod and the ReplicaSet replaces it, repeating every few minutes. Root cause object: the thumbnailer Deployment (its log-shipper container spec and the missing collector dependency).

findings.name: web

diagnosis.summary: Audited orders, status, checkout. orders: orders-api Deployment crash-loops because DATABASE_URL is never configured (no env/envFrom on the pod); root cause is the Deployment's missing config. checkout: healthy Deployment (1/1) but Service 'checkout' selector app=checkout-v2 matches no pods (pods are labeled app=checkout), leaving zero endpoints. status: deployment 1/1, service selector matches its pod, no problem pods or warnings — healthy."

findings.name: web
findings.root_cause: Readiness probe targets http://:8081/ but the nginx container listens on port 80 (no containerPort/env override, no custom config), so every probe gets connection refused and the pod stays NotReady (0/1) with no endpoints for traffic.
findings.fix: Change the readinessProbe httpGet port in Deployment web from 8081 to 80 (or make nginx listen on 8081 via a mounted config).

diagnosis.summary: web/web is Running but 0/1 Ready: the readiness probe (httpGet / on port 8081) fails with 'connection refused' (event ev-12bbd1, 25x) because the stock nginx:1.29-alpine container serves on port 80 — logs show a clean nginx startup with no errors and no config change. No Service exists in the namespace, so nothing else is masking this. Fix: point the readiness probe at port 80 (or configure nginx for 8081).

findings.fix: Point checkout-web's trust volume at the CA that now issues the payments-api certificate: change the Deployment's 'trust' volume from configMap legacy-ca to internal-ca (ca.crt), then roll the pods.
findings.name: checkout-web
findings.root_cause: After the migration, payments-api serves a cert issued by 'Internal Services CA 2026', but checkout-web verifies upstreams against legacy-ca ('Legacy Services CA 2021'), so /pay fails SSL verification and returns 502. payments-api itself is up and ready.

diagnosis.summary: payments-api is NOT down: pod Running/Ready, Service has 1 ready endpoint. The 502s come from checkout-web (nginx): logs show repeated 'upstream SSL certificate verify error (21: unable to verify the first certificate)' proxying /pay to https://payments-api:443. checkout-web mounts legacy-ca (Legacy Services CA 2021) as its trust bundle, while migrated payments-api uses a cert from Internal Services CA 2026 (both CAs valid). Fix: mount internal-ca in checkout-web instead of legacy-ca.
